# Annual Exceedance Probability (AEP)

## Rock (Vs30 = 1100 m/s)

```{r}
Vs30_TARGET <- 1100
Tn_TARGET <- c(0,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.5,1.0)
CAP <-  "Annual Exceedence Probabilities (AEP) in terms of spectral pseudo-accelerations  Sa(Tn) for structural periods Tn ranging between %g to %g. Spectral ordinates were obtained for rock site conditions with Vs30 = %g  m/s (Quantile p=%s)"
```


:::  {.panel-tabset  }

### mean

```{r}
p_TARGET <- "mean"
```
{{< include qmd/_fig.AEP.qmd >}}

```{r}
p_TARGET <- 0.50
```

## Seismic Coefficients $k_h$ & $k_{max}$

```{r}

CAP <-  "Horizontal seismic (pseudo-static) coefficients for %s. Spectral ordinates obtained for Maximum Design Earthquake (MDE) with an AEP=1/%d yr, assuming geotechnical site conditions with Vs30=%g  m/s. Seismic coefficients obtained for slopes with a fundamental period of Td=%g s and residual deformations ranging from %g cm (%g %% Hs) to %g cm (%g %% Hs). Quantile p=%s."
```
